description_en: Queries the information about the databases and tables that can be restored from a specified backup set
description_zh: 该接口用于查询目标备份集中可恢复的库表信息
name: DescribeMetaList

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The restore method. Valid values:

BackupSetID: restores data from a backup set. If you set this parameter to BackupSetID, you must also specify the BackupSetID parameter.
RestoreTime: restores data to a specific point in time. If you set this parameter to RestoreTime, you must also specify the RestoreTime parameter.

Default value: BackupSetID
parameters.help_zh:
恢复方式，取值：

BackupSetID：基于备份集恢复，您还需要传入参数BackupSetID。
RestoreTime：基于时间点恢复，您还需要传入参数RestoreTime。

默认值：BackupSetID
parameters.name: restore_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set that is used to query data when the restore method is based on a backup set. You can call the DescribeBackups operation to query the ID.
This parameter is required when RestoreType is set to BackupSetID
parameters.help_zh:
基于备份集查询时，使用的备份集的ID。可调用DescribeBackups获取。
RestoreType为BackupSetID时必传
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore data. The time must be earlier than the current time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. You can call the DescribeBackups operation to query the time. This parameter is required when RestoreType is set to RestoreTime
parameters.help_zh: 基于时间点查询时，使用的时间节点，需要早于当前时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。可调用DescribeBackups获取。 RestoreType为RestoreTime时必传
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database to query. Exact match is used. The specific database name and all tables in the database are returned.
If this parameter is left empty, a list of all databases is returned
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的数据库名。精确匹配，会返回具体的数据库名以及库内所有的表。
为空则返回包含所有数据库的列表
parameters.name: get_db_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database to query. Fuzzy match is used. Only the matched database names are returned, and table names are not returned.
For example, if you specify `test`, `testdb1` and `testdb2` are matched. After you determine the name of the target database, you can specify the exact database name in the GetDbName parameter to view the information about all tables in the target database
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的数据库名。模糊匹配，只返回匹配的数据库名，不返回表名。
例如传入`test`匹配`testdb1`和`testdb2`，确定目标数据库名称后再通过GetDbName参数传入精确的数据库名称查看目标库下所有表的信息
parameters.name: pattern

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Default value: 1.
This parameter takes effect only when it is used together with PageIndex
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。默认值：1。
需要和PageIndex一起传入才生效
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: any integer greater than 0 and less than or equal to the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1.
This parameter takes effect only when it is used together with PageSize
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。默认值：1。
需要和PageSize一起传入才生效
parameters.name: page_index

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

schema.description_en: The details of the response parameters

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries on the current page
